phases.description: Open refrigerator, handle red-liquid bottles, close refrigerator
Carry materials between work areas; background walking excluded

visual_observations.description: Refrigerator opens; red-liquid bottles are handled; door is closed. Reagent identities are unresolved.
A red-liquid bottle is placed on the bench beside the microscope; another bottle is carried nearby.

video-102_singular_display.title: Cabinet preparation, plate retrieval and microscope handling

phases.description: Wipe motion across cabinet surface; wipe detector is unvalidated
Open incubator and retrieve culture plate
Carry plate to microscope, position it and adjust instrument

visual_observations.description: Spray bottle is handled and aimed at cabinet surfaces. Chemical identity, coverage and effective decontamination are unverified.
Hand with a light-colored wipe moves across the work surface. Surface sterility is not measurable from this view.
Incubator opens and a labeled multiwell plate is carried away. Persistent plate ID has not been read.
Plate is positioned at the microscope and instrument controls are handled; cellular images and conclusions are not visible.

video-108_singular_display.title: Bottle, plate and pipette preparation at cabinet

visual_observations.description: Culture-plate stack and lid are handled at the cabinet; exact plate identity needs review.
Both hands manipulate the bottle cap. Exact uncapping/recapping boundaries require closer review.
Long pipette is positioned into/over the multiwell plate. Aspiration versus dispense and transferred volume are unresolved.
Pipette/controller and bottle are handled; attachment and liquid movement need review.
Further plate/tool interaction; compare well order and dwell only after tip tracking is validated.
Long pipette/packaging and controller are handled near bottle and plates.

phases.description: Open inner door and place plate on shelf
Close inner and outer incubator doors

visual_observations.description: Labeled plate is picked up and carried from cabinet toward incubator.
Inner door opens and a plate is placed on a shelf. Occlusion prevents continuous verification of identity.
Inner and outer incubator doors are closed.
